changeSet.sql: with nc_requests as (select r.* from request r where r.type in ('NON_COMPLIANCE', 'AVIATION_NON_COMPLIANCE') and r.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'), nc_tasks as (select rt.* from request_task rt join nc_requests on rt.request_id = nc_requests.id where rt.payload -> 'reason' is null and rt.type not in ('AVIATION_NON_COMPLIANCE_APPLICATION_SUBMIT','NON_COMPLIANCE_APPLICATION_SUBMIT')), nc_actions as (select ra.* from request_action ra join nc_tasks on ra.request_id = nc_tasks.request_id and ra."type" in ('NON_COMPLIANCE_APPLICATION_SUBMITTED', 'NON_COMPLIANCE_DETAILS_AMENDED')), nc_max_creation_date_per_request_id as (select nc_actions.request_id, max(nc_actions.creation_date) as max_action from nc_actions group by nc_actions.request_id), nc_most_recent_action_pre_request_id as (select nc_actions.* from nc_actions join nc_max_creation_date_per_request_id on nc_actions.request_id = nc_max_creation_date_per_request_id.request_id and nc_max_creation_date_per_request_id.max_action = nc_actions.creation_date) update request_task rt set payload = rt.payload || jsonb_build_object( 'reason', ncmra.payload -> 'reason', 'complianceDate', ncmra.payload -> 'complianceDate', 'nonComplianceDate', ncmra.payload -> 'nonComplianceDate', 'nonComplianceComments', ncmra.payload -> 'comments' ) from nc_most_recent_action_pre_request_id ncmra where rt.request_id = ncmra.request_id and rt.id in (select id from nc_tasks);
